title: W3 fix claimed ("econ-check wired into CI") but no CI wiring exists anywhere in the PR — the crisis-stall gate is still manual-only
location: .github/workflows/ci.yml (absence); PR body lines 39+87; commit 6e3a3c8 message; harness/main.odin:101
evidence: Commit 6e3a3c8 message: "- W3: econ-check wired into CI (environment-blind: deterministic T1 sim)." PR body line 39: "The gates run in CI now (environment-blind: deterministic T1 sim)." PR body line 87: "econ-check wired into CI (environment-blind, no longer manual-only)". Verified against the code: `git diff v2..HEAD -- .github/workflows/ci.yml tools/ci-local.sh tools/harness.sh | grep -i econ` returns ZERO matches (ci.yml's only PR change is the r1 golden-leg demotion in 7208ec5); the only caller of econ_check in the tree is the manual harness verb at harness/main.odin:101: "code := econ_check(&cat)"; `grep -rn "econ-check" .github tools` matches nothing. The gate itself works locally (I ran ./bin/harness econ-check: "econ-check: all scenario verdicts hold", exit 0) — it is just not wired anywhere automatic.
detail: The r3 W3 finding (crisis-stall gate manual-only) remains unfixed: ci.yml, ci-local.sh and harness.sh contain no econ-check invocation, so the Q7 gate still runs only when a human remembers. Meanwhile the commit message and PR body assert the CI wiring twice — a fresh over-claim of the exact W4 pattern r3 flagged.
recommended_fix: Add a CI step running `tools/harness.sh econ-check` (deterministic, environment-blind) to ci.yml and mirror it in tools/ci-local.sh; or correct the commit/PR-body claims to "manual verb, run locally" and record W3 as open.
